nodes.label: dashboard/index.html (Grok AI Trading Command Center SPA)
Six-agent trading pipeline (Market/News Analyst -> Strategy -> Risk -> approval -> Portfolio -> Performance)
Known bug: daily loss baseline never resets
nodes.rationale: day_start_equity is set only when the account is created or reset (app/broker.py:23, :56), so the daily loss limit behaves as 'loss since start or reset' and blocks BUYs until Reset account.

nodes.label: Known bug: human approval skips Risk Manager re-check
nodes.rationale: Approving a pending BUY fills the original quantity at the current price without re-running the Risk Manager, so max-positions and crypto-exposure limits can be exceeded (offline test: 7 positions vs limit 5, 45.7% crypto vs 30%).

nodes.label: Drawdown kill switch (latched, reviewed reset)
nodes.rationale: Fires at the max drawdown from peak, blocks new BUYs, survives new days and restarts; only a human-reviewed reset (reviewer, note, confirm phrase, fresh prices) clears it and re-bases the peak. No AI can reset it.

nodes.label: Losing-streak cooldown
nodes.rationale: After max_consecutive_losses closed losing trades, new BUYs pause for cooldown_hours; exits stay allowed.

nodes.label: Simulation-only / no real money policy
nodes.rationale: Every view is labeled simulation only: offline demo data, paper ledgers, no brokerage, no real orders, educational not financial advice.

nodes.label: Grok research-only policy
nodes.rationale: Grok returns research for display only; it cannot place, size or approve orders, change risk limits, or bypass the Risk Manager or human approval, and its market research is not used in trade decisions.

nodes.label: SIMULATED_APPROVAL backtest policy
nodes.rationale: Backtest-only policy modeling approval of past proposals; distinct from human approval and never reaches the live approval path (alternative: PROPOSAL_ONLY, no fills).
